title: Evaluate refined setup metadata honestly
description: Re-evaluate non-contradictory newly supplied setup detail without automatically invalidating prior observations or inventing compatibility.
acceptanceCriteria: Unknown-to-known refinement is represented distinctly from unchanged, contradiction, and exact historical match
Refinement triggers central compatibility re-evaluation with provenance-aware reasons or confirmations
Existing observation references remain intact unless an explicit incompatibility rule applies
No refinement alone yields physical validity, suitability, or automatic compatibility

steps.details: Include normalized refinement provenance and prior unknown state in the compatibility request where needed for explanation.
Return a stable refinement reason/confirmation while preserving any independent mismatch and avoiding blanket invalidation.
Explain the newly known field and required operator action in shared compatibility UI without claiming observation verification.
Cover one/multiple refinements, unchanged provenance, unrelated mismatch, contradiction, retained observation identity, and repeat evaluation.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; reuse refinement provenance and compatibility presentation seams.
Refinement preserves history; it does not retroactively rewrite the assumptions under which data was recorded.
